requirements.description: Configure Vitest with proper environments for 4-tier testing
steps: Review current vitest.config.ts and identify needed changes
Configure Vitest projects for unit vs integration separation
Set up 'node' environment for Tier 2 (logic) tests
Configure 'nuxt' environment for Tier 3 (integration) tests
Verify tests can run with 'vitest --project unit' and 'vitest --project integration'
Update package.json scripts to match new structure

requirements.description: Extract and test navigation resolver logic
steps: Create lib/navigation/resolver.ts from app/utils/navigation.ts logic
Extract resolveNavItem() as pure function
Write lib/navigation/resolver.test.ts with 3-5 test cases
Test matching root paths, child paths, and tab resolution
Verify tests run with 'vitest --project unit'
Ensure no Nuxt imports or DOM dependencies in logic tests

requirements.description: Test courseApi utilities if business logic exists
steps: Review app/utils/courseApi/ directory for pure functions
Identify functions with conditional logic or calculations
Extract any business logic to lib/ directory
Write co-located tests for extracted functions
Verify 2-3 key utility functions have passing tests
Create tests/api/projects.test.ts for integration tests
Test GET /api/projects returns array of projects
Test POST /api/projects creates project with valid data
Test POST /api/projects returns 400 for invalid data
Test GET /api/projects/:id returns single project
Test PATCH /api/projects/:id updates project
Test DELETE /api/projects/:id removes project
Verify all tests pass with 'vitest --project integration'
Create tests/api/health.test.ts
Test GET /api/health returns status and platform info
Verify response includes 'ok' or 'degraded' status
Check response has timestamp and database status
Test passes without external dependencies

requirements.description: Test database connectivity in integration layer
steps: Create tests/api/setup that configures test database
Set up in-memory SQLite database for tests
Create test fixture for sample project data
Verify database tests use isolated transactions
Test that useDb() composable works in test context
Create lib/ directory at root for pure logic
Move navigation resolver and other logic to lib/
Create tests/api/ directory for integration tests
Create tests/fixtures/ for shared test data
Document pattern: Tier 2 co-located, Tier 3 in tests/api/
Update AGENTS.md with testing conventions section

requirements.description: Create example composable test for useProjects
steps: Create app/composables/useProjects.spec.ts as example
Test composable initialization and state
Use registerEndpoint() to mock API calls
Verify composable calls correct endpoints
Show pattern for testing other composables
Keep test focused on composable behavior, not component rendering
Create TESTING.md at project root
Explain 4-tier testing strategy briefly
Document when to write Tier 2 vs Tier 3 tests
Provide examples of each test type
Include commands to run different test tiers
Reference nuxt-testing skill for detailed guidance

requirements.description: Validate tests run successfully in CI configuration
steps: Ensure 'pnpm run test' runs all test tiers
Verify 'pnpm run test:unit' runs only Tier 2 tests
Confirm tests pass locally without external services
Check that tests don't require real LLM or database connections
Document any environment setup required for tests
